stem:
Yvonne is using a coordinate grid for the first time. She wants to find the location of the ordered pair (3, 7) on the grid.

Starting at the origin, which movement should Yvonne do first?

options.label: F
options.text: Move right along the x-axis to 3

options.label: G
options.text: Move up along the y-axis to 3

options.label: H
options.text: Move right along the y-axis to 7

options.label: J
options.text: Move up along the x-axis to 7
